query_normalized: leveraging llms for automated generation of code complexity metrics computer science
rationale: The paper focuses on video quality assessment (VQA) for user-generated content using deep learning, which is a distinct domain from the user's question about leveraging LLMs to generate code complexity metrics. It fails to address the specific mechanism (LLMs), the target domain (code), or the specific variable (complexity metrics), and instead belongs to the unrelated field of multimedia quality evaluation.
